facts.fact: The OTC signed a USD 50m, three-year contract with the Samsung C&T Consortium for the Tunisian land information system, to digitise all OTC archives, build a land database and an integrated cadastral information system, with infrastructure in the OTC's 24 arrondissements, per OTC head Ahmed El Kamel.
